summary.en: Code editor with an official Windows Arm64 installer.
summary.zh-TW: 提供官方 Windows Arm64 安裝程式的程式碼編輯器。

caveats.en: The release asset is named Zed-aarch64.exe next to Zed-x86_64.exe; the release page does not say it was tested on RTX Spark.
caveats.zh-TW: 發行頁的資產為 Zed-aarch64.exe，與 Zed-x86_64.exe 並列；頁面沒有說明是否在 RTX Spark 上測試過。
